title: BlackRock's $1.9 Billion Credit Hedge Fund Suffers Worst January
主要内容: BlackRock Inc.’s global credit hedge fund suffered its worst January performance in its 19-year history, falling 4 percent due to a selloff in bonds amid falling oil prices and rising recession concerns. The $1.9 billion Obsidian fund failed to anticipate the extent to which markets would trade in lockstep with commodities, according to an investor update. The fund lost money from corporate credit and global-rate strategies.
